scope: cargo-rstyle binary and rstyle-core non-test library
basis: Before capture, source call sites in cargo-rstyle main::analyze, analysis::source_rules, capture and advisory::{propagation,diagnostics} independently require these seven ordinary rstyle-core free-function targets. Both selected packages fit the unchanged 256-file source census limit. rstyle-pdg is not selected, so its workspace callees must remain unresolved. This study measures dependency call coverage; it does not establish purity, a speedup or complete strict matching.
